message.content:
**How Turbonomic Helps Unilever Leverage AI for Multi‑Cloud Observability**

| Capability | What Turbonomic Provides | Why It Matters for Unilever |
|------------|--------------------------|-----------------------------|
| **Unified Visibility** | Real‑time dashboards that aggregate metrics from AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, VMware, and on‑prem environments. | Unilever can see all workloads in one pane, reducing the “cloud‑silos” problem and speeding up incident response. |
| **AI‑Driven Recommendations** | Machine‑learning models that predict resource demand, auto‑scale, right‑size, and place workloads optimally across clouds. | AI reduces manual tuning, cuts waste, and ensures performance for mission‑critical retail and supply‑chain apps. |
| **Cost Optimization & Forecasting** | AI forecasts spend, allocates cost to business units, and recommends right‑sizing or spot‑instance usage. | Unilever can track spend by product line, forecast budgets, and negotiate better cloud contracts. |
| **Policy & Compliance Automation** | Policy engine that enforces security, compliance, and governance rules across all clouds. | Ensures data residency, GDPR, and internal policies are met without manual checks. |
| **Capacity Planning & Capacity Forecasting** | Predictive analytics for future capacity needs, helping plan migrations or expansions. | Enables proactive scaling for seasonal demand spikes (e.g., holiday sales). |
| **Root‑Cause Analysis & Alerting** | Correlates metrics, logs, and events to pinpoint issues quickly. | Reduces MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) for critical services. |
| **Integration with CI/CD & DevOps** | APIs and plugins for Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, etc. | Seamless automation of workload placement and scaling decisions. |

**How Turbonomic Differs from Native Cloud Tools**

| Feature | Turbonomic | Native Cloud Tools (AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Operations) |
|---------|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Scope** | Cross‑cloud, multi‑tenant, multi‑platform (public, private, hybrid). | Single‑cloud, platform‑specific. |
| **Observability** | Unified dashboards, AI‑driven insights, predictive analytics. | Cloud‑specific dashboards, limited cross‑cloud correlation. |
| **Cost Management** | AI‑based forecasting, allocation, and optimization across all clouds. | Native cost explorer tools are cloud‑specific and lack AI forecasting. |
| **Policy Enforcement** | Central policy engine that applies rules across all environments. | Each cloud has its own IAM/Policy system; no single policy view. |
| **Auto‑Scaling & Right‑Sizing** | AI predicts demand and recommends scaling actions automatically. | Native auto‑scaling is rule‑based and requires manual configuration per cloud. |
| **Root‑Cause Analysis** | Correlates metrics, logs, and events across clouds. | Native tools provide logs and metrics but lack cross‑cloud correlation. |
| **Integration** | APIs, SDKs, and plugins for Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, etc. | Native tools integrate only within their own ecosystem. |
| **Governance & Compliance** | Unified compliance reporting and audit trails. | Cloud‑specific compliance dashboards; no unified view. |

### Bottom Line for Unilever

- **Single Pane of Glass**: Turbonomic gives Unilever a unified view of all workloads, regardless of where they run.
- **AI‑Powered Decision Making**: AI models reduce manual effort, cut costs, and improve performance.
- **Cross‑Cloud Governance**: One policy engine enforces security and compliance across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on‑prem.
- **Cost Savings & Forecasting**: AI forecasts spend and recommends right‑sizing, helping Unilever stay within budget and negotiate better contracts.

By adopting Turbonomic, Unilever can move from reactive, siloed cloud management to proactive, AI‑driven multi‑cloud observability and optimization—ultimately delivering faster time‑to‑market, lower costs, and stronger compliance.
